home.x: This is the home screen. Below the logo is our web address; in the centre the Basmala and a wisdom that changes on every launch.
Type a surah's name (e.g. "Yasin") or its number to find it quickly.
Tap a surah to open the reading screen.
Khatm/juz' sharing and group dhikr are here. Share all 30 juz' with a single link — no sign-up, no one needs to install the app. Everyone taps the link, picks a juz', and marks it when read.
Return to the last verse you reached with a single tap.
Your collection, notes, bookmarks and difficult spots are gathered here.
Test mode, daily revision plan and your memorization progress are here.
Your memorization tracking and daily revision plan.
Change the app's colour and appearance from here.

reader.x: Jump directly to one of the Mushaf's 604 pages.
Jump to one of the 30 juz'. Each juz' starts at the top of its own page.
To move to another surah, pick it from the list or search.
Tap a word and the verse is recited while the words are highlighted in sync. Press and hold to select word by word.
Turns the Latin-letter transliteration under the verses on or off.
Set the script (Uthman Taha etc.) and the font size from here.
Lists the verses one under another, line by line — handy for memorizing.
First tap the Bookmark button, then tap the verse where you want to place the ribbon.
Collection, notes, bookmarks and difficult spots.
Fine-tune repetition, waiting, speed and the memorization programme.
Set how many times a verse/segment is repeated. Change it with − and +.
Reads the verses cumulatively: 1, then 1+2, then 1+2+3…
Plays the selected verse or where you left off; your settings are applied.

ayarlar.x: Set ready-made themes, night/paper mode and your own colour from here.
You can also change the default reciter from here.
Download surah audio and listen without internet.
Turns on the transliteration for those who cannot read the Arabic script.
The text, script and audio sources are stated here.

ezber.x: Verses you mark as "memorized" are gathered here; the app reminds you of revision times itself (as new memorization, near revision and far revision).

birlikte.x: Share all 30 juz' with a single link. Tap "Start khatm" and write your intention. The app creates two links: a join link (send it to the group) and an admin link (keep it — don't give it to anyone).
Set a common goal: 1000 salawat, 313 Ayat al-Kursi… Count by tapping the ring, then press "Add my share to the goal". Who read how much is not shown — only the total.
Paste the link from the group here. Or simply tapping the link is enough.
The khatms you started and joined are here.

org.x: Grey = empty, tap to take. Yellow = taken, not yet read. Green = read. Red = overdue.
Creates a ready WhatsApp message listing the missing juz'.

saved.x: Spots you got stuck on; tap to go to that verse.
